description: "The Magician's Show Box, and Other Stories" by Lydia Maria Child is a collection of children's stories written during the mid-19th century.
longDescription: The tales are rich in imagination and fantastical elements, often reflecting a longing for adventure and the wonders of the world through the eyes of young characters.

authorInfo.bio: Caroline Sturgis Tappan · Lydia Maria Child (1819–1888) wrote The Magician's Show Box, and Other Stories. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
